rules.title: Weak cryptographic primitive
rules.condition: An algorithm uses MD5, SHA-1, DES, 3DES or RC4.
rules.recommendation: Replace with a modern primitive such as AES-GCM, SHA-256/SHA-384, or an approved signature algorithm.

rules.title: RSA key size below the minimum
rules.condition: An RSA algorithm declares a key smaller than {minimumRsaBits} bits.
rules.recommendation: Rotate to RSA-{minimumRsaBits} or stronger, or an approved elliptic-curve/post-quantum alternative.

rules.title: Quantum-vulnerable asymmetric cryptography
rules.condition: An algorithm uses RSA, DSA, ECC/ECDSA/ECDH, Diffie-Hellman, EdDSA, X25519/X448 or ElGamal, which a cryptographically relevant quantum computer can break.
rules.recommendation: Track migration plans and prefer hybrid or post-quantum schemes (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) where supported.

rules.title: Certificate is expired
rules.condition: A certificate's expiry date (notValidAfter) is in the past.
rules.recommendation: Replace or renew the certificate immediately.

rules.title: Weak certificate signature algorithm
rules.condition: A certificate is signed with SHA-1 or MD5.
rules.recommendation: Reissue the certificate with SHA-256 or stronger signature algorithms.

rules.title: Deprecated cryptographic protocol
rules.condition: A protocol declares SSL, TLS 1.0 or TLS 1.1.
rules.recommendation: Disable deprecated protocols and require TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 as appropriate.

rules.title: Cryptographic material is marked compromised
rules.condition: A key, secret or credential is declared with state compromised.
rules.recommendation: Revoke, rotate, and investigate all dependent systems.

rules.title: Sensitive material stored in environment variables
rules.condition: A key, secret or credential declares environment-variable storage.
rules.recommendation: Move sensitive material to a managed secret store with rotation and audit controls.

rules.title: Cryptographic material usage is not documented
rules.condition: A key, secret or credential does not declare where it is used (usedIn).
rules.recommendation: Document consuming systems so rotation and incident response can be targeted.

rules.title: Weak cryptographic asset
rules.condition: An asset of unknown or unrecognised type declares a weak primitive (MD5, SHA-1, DES, 3DES, RC4).
rules.recommendation: Replace with a modern approved primitive.
